children: Further to the announcement of 13 October 2025 outlining a planned programme of share purchases to be made by the Forterra Employee Benefit Trust whereby 150,000 ordinary shares are to be purchased each month.

On 15 September 2026 the Company was notified by Apex Financial Services (Trust Company) Limited, acting as Trustee that on 15 September 2026 the Trust completed the purchase of 75,000 ordinary shares of 1p each in the Company at an average price of £1.33281.
The Trust holds shares for the benefit of the Company's employees and in particular for the satisfying of awards made under the Company's various share schemes.
The Trust now holds 3,315,148 ordinary shares in the Company representing 1.63% of the Company’s current voting rights.
Further information relating to the Company and its group can be found at www.forterraplc.co.uk
